notes:
Photos fill their bubble and open full screen when tapped.
Videos show their picture with a play button; the size in the corner downloads them, and they play inside Rabta.
Hold a message to select it: reply, star, delete or forward it, also several at once. Photos, videos and voice messages have a forward button beside them.
Only one voice message plays at a time.
The chats list shows a photo or video icon for photos and videos.
